mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near the Verona Public Library and a beautiful Waxing Gibbous moon visible in the night sky.

The city is recruiting an Engineering Technician to help manage municipal construction and utility projects, with applications due September 20. Additionally, the city has implemented a new rain barrel rebate program offering up to 30 dollars back for property owners, while also adjusting sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Starting tomorrow, look forward to trivia nights at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, with more events like the downtown farmer's market and live music at Paddy Mac's occurring throughout the week.
In a noteworthy call from Friday, August 15, Verona police officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after she was found unresponsive in her vehicle and later attempted to drive away.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store is currently closed, but they will be open and ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow.
